promptPrefix: Authentic period portrait photograph, historically accurate to the era and photographic technology depicted —
promptSuffix: Period-accurate photographic format, lighting, costume and aesthetic throughout, as if genuinely taken then.
variantDirectives: Wide period frame, the sitters small within the studio or street:
Full-length period frame, posture and gesture carry the feeling:
Tight period portrait, faces fill the frame:
Stark single-light period composition, plain and minimal:
The period setting dominates the frame, the sitters secondary:
Period clothing takes centre stage, the sitters framed to show the dress:

translations.formal vs. candid: the gap between the face prepared for the camera and the one caught without warning
translations.posed vs. caught: the difference between what was arranged and what happened
translations.preserved vs. faded: what the photograph kept and what it let go
translations.public face vs. private moment: the version given to the lens and the version that slipped through
translations.stiff vs. tender: the posture held for the exposure and the feeling underneath it
translations.the sitter vs. the subject: who came to be photographed and who the photograph found
translations.performance vs. presence: when the act drops and there is only the person
translations.the person vs. the image: what the camera recorded and what it missed entirely
translations.together vs. separate in time: two people in the same frame from different moments
translations.dignity vs. vulnerability: the composure maintained and the composure that almost broke
translations.dressed up vs. undone: the Sunday best and the person inside it
translations.looking vs. looked at: the eye behind the lens and the eye in front of it
translations.known vs. unrecognised: the face in the photograph that no one can name
translations.held vs. released: what the archive keeps and what it lets go
translations.the face given vs. the face kept: what was offered to the photographer and what was withheld
